Rigid Gas Permeable (RGP) lenses offer a highly effective, non-surgical solution for patients who are not suitable for laser vision correction or who prefer a reversible option. At Optimax Eye Specialist Malaysia, RGP lenses are custom-fitted to provide sharp, stable vision — especially for complex eye conditions such as irregular astigmatism or keratoconus.
Designed to maintain their shape on the eye, RGP lenses deliver clearer, more consistent vision than conventional soft contact lenses.

sections.heading: What Are Rigid Gas Permeable (RGP) lenses?

items.v:
Rigid Gas Permeable (RGP) lenses are advanced contact lenses made from oxygen-permeable materials that allow the cornea to breathe while maintaining a stable optical surface. Unlike soft lenses, RGP lenses retain their shape, helping to correct vision more effectively in eyes with irregular corneal contours.
At Optimax, RGP lenses are customised using advanced corneal imaging and precision fitting techniques, ensuring each lens is tailored to the unique shape and visual needs of your eyes.
*RGP lenses offer excellent optical performance and longer lifespan than soft contacts when cared for properly

yes.heading: Who Can Benefit from Rigid Gas Permeable (RGP) lenses?

items.v: RGP lenses may be suitable if you:

v: Are not suitable for LASIK or other laser procedures
Prefer a non-surgical and reversible vision correction option

items.v: A comprehensive eye assessment will determine whether RGP lenses are right for you.

no.heading: Who Is Not Suitable for Rigid Gas Permeable (RGP) lenses?

items.v: RGP lenses may not be suitable for individuals who:

v: Are unable to adapt to rigid lenses after an adjustment period
Have certain eye surface conditions that prevent lens wear
Are unable to maintain proper lens hygiene or follow-up care

items.v: Our optometrists will advise on alternative solutions if RGP lenses are not recommended.
